component.name: hearth
component.summary: Play AC-3, E-AC-3 and AC-4 streams on speakers, a receiver or a Sendspin network

description.p: hearth is the ICL Forge desktop player. It plays AC-3, E-AC-3 (with Dolby Atmos objects) and AC-4 (channel-based, immersive and object content), decodes to a chosen speaker layout with each format's decoder settings, and plays to a local device or to a group of Sendspin network sinks. AC-3 and E-AC-3 streams can also be sent to a receiver over HDMI or S/PDIF as a bitstream. In a group, the ESP32 sinks take AC-3 and E-AC-3 only.
